vocab.definition: amount of reactant used or product made ÷ time.
a straight line touching a curve to find the rate.
change in y ÷ change in x of a tangent.
g/s, cm³/s or mol/s depending on what is measured.

misconceptions.right: Rate is fastest at the start and slows down.

misconceptions.wrong: A steeper curve means a slower rate.
misconceptions.right: A steeper gradient means a faster rate.

misconceptions.wrong: Rate is read straight off a curve.
misconceptions.right: Draw a tangent and find its gradient.

infoPanels.title: MEAN RATE
formulaLines: mean rate = quantity of reactant or producttime taken
infoPanels.content: Rate is fastest at the start

questions.text: A graph levels off at 80 cm³. State what this shows about the reaction. [1 mark]

footer.tip: Mean rate = amount ÷ time. For an instant rate, use the gradient of a tangent.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why is the gradient steepest at the very start of the reaction?
